pocs.name: Cold-start comprehension
pocs.proves: A fresh reader can recover exact project truth within 15 minutes.
pocs.missing: V1 exact vocabulary and V2 hidden evidence allowlist were INVALID-INSTRUMENT. Requires a disclosed or content-validated evidence policy and a new independent run.

pocs.name: Deceptive-green evaluator
pocs.proves: A protected artifact scorer catches a defect that a source-tree check misses.

pocs.name: Context-loss recovery
pocs.proves: A new session resumes correctly from repository state without oral reconstruction.
pocs.missing: Frozen interruption scenario and blinded recovery scorer.

pocs.name: Verified-loop accounting
pocs.proves: Infrastructure output and invalidated work do not inflate verified progress.

pocs.name: Retraction propagation
pocs.proves: A forbidden retracted token turns the project verification red.

pocs.name: Second-project transplant
pocs.proves: The portable core installs without overwriting target-owned files.
pocs.missing: Independent cold onboarding; local technical checks alone cannot close it.

pocs.name: Safe upgrade and fork protection
pocs.proves: An upgrade replaces only provenance-matched bytes and refuses local modifications.

pocs.name: Human intervention capture
pocs.proves: Human actions, latency, and purpose can be captured without retrospective invention.
pocs.missing: Event schema, low-friction logger, and missingness control.

pocs.name: Bare-versus-SEED calibration
pocs.proves: SEED changes invalid claims, correctness, recovery cost, or human time causally.
pocs.missing: Task corpus, priced execution, twelve matched pairs, and blinded analysis.

pocs.name: Public thermometer
pocs.proves: The evidence can be rendered as an honest, legible capability-and-human-delta surface.
pocs.missing: Validated upstream measurements and a non-actuating public prototype.
